Title: Admins' Microsoft Defender XDR advanced hunting queries that contain a customer-defined function may fail

User impact: Admins' Microsoft Defender XDR advanced hunting queries that contain a customer-defined function may fail.

More info: All advanced hunting queries that contain a customer-defined function may fail, including custom detection, public API and portal.

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue with Microsoft Defender XDR and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.
